caveats: Identity boundary: Kim Kwang Jin (김관진) is the defendant charged in N.D. Ga. No. 1:25-CR-291. P.S. is a source-redacted identity-victim label allegedly misused by Kim, not a civil identity to identify or profile. Pemba Sherpa, Pemba Gulu, and paladin-120 remain publisher-attributed or legacy OSINT links rather than official identity determinations; current account control is unverified.
Charges are allegations; the subject is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty.
P.S. is a source-redacted victim label allegedly misused by the defendant, not a public employment persona or a person to identify, profile, or contact.

The indictment describes the employment alias as a real victim's identity, redacted as 'P.S.'. This site therefore does not treat the 'Pemba Sherpa' persona name as fabricated, and does not assert that any named person is 'P.S.'.
